the duplicated segment present in the cellulosomal protein CipA and in the cellulase CelD recognizes a set of proteins which are different.

the binding specificities of the duplicated segments of C. thermosulfurogenes CelA, of C. cellulovorans CelD and of the cellulosome of C. cellulolyticum are similar, whereas those of C. thermohydrosulfurigenes CelA, C. thermocelium CelD and C. thermocellularum ORF3p are different.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the duplicated segments of C. thermoceullum proteins are not specific for CipA.
the duplicated segments of C. thermocollem proteins are able to recognize the same set of C. cellulolyticum proteins, but they are not able to bind each other.
the duplicated segments of the cellulosomal enzymes CelD and CipA are specific for distinct sets of C. thermocollem proteins.
